lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15 high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth branchial slit, with a primary horizontal row of maximal luminance situated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs at near-perpendicular angles, creating a grid of high-contrast nodes across the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent exhibit a sharp vertical gradient with high pixel intensity on the superior surface and deep shadow on the inferior surface, extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: High density of low-luminance, elongated silhouettes (commensal organisms) clustered adjacent to the branchial region and the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
